event_assertions.name: same row binds two process lifetimes

notes: One DSH TUI session completes a tool-free turn, exits cleanly, then relaunches with --resume and the same session ID in the same cwd. The recipe waits beyond irrlichd's 10-second deleted-session cooldown before resume and waits again before the second prompt. All lifecycle phases pin to the original session-UUID row. Transcript assertions require one durable session header with two user turns and two completed boundaries. Event assertions require one session ID across transcript births and two distinct bound PIDs.

text: The first DSH launch creates one real session-UUID row in ready
Lifetime 1 binds its process through session.lock
The first prompt moves the durable session from ready to working
The first completed turn returns the session to ready
Clean /exit ends lifetime 1 and removes the live row
Fresh activity after relaunch recreates the SAME session ID in ready, not a new row
The same row binds the resumed process lifetime after the first process exited
The second prompt moves the resumed session from ready to working
The second completed turn returns the same session to ready
